_comment: Export… (publication figure) of the emtk app, drawn by emtk.view_form over ndxplorer.app.features.playback_export.PublicationExportModel. The Qt window's PublicationExportDialog, as a spec: the figure is composed by ndxplorer.export.publication_figure (Matplotlib) and handed to app.io_service as bytes (a path on a desktop, a download in a browser).

sections.label: Format:
sections.description: Vector (PDF/SVG) is resolution-independent and best for print; PNG is a high-resolution raster.

sections.label: DPI (raster):
sections.description: Raster resolution. Ignored for vector formats.

sections.label: Include X/Y marginal histograms
sections.description: Draw the x and y marginal histograms above and beside the 2-D density.

buttons.label: Export…
buttons.description: Ask where to save, then write the figure.
